comments.author: Anne.Bonny
comments.body:
It really depends on where and when these weapons are being used. The key here lies on which job you are in. You either go for a Sword Mastery favoured job like Sword Master or Swordfighter in which then Excalibur's 15 attack will work better, or go for jobs where Sword Mastery isn't favoured, whereby then Kanemoto's Sword Mastery advantage makes 10+10 much easier to be achieved.

This is actually rather pivotal in the maritiming community considering the introduction of Deck Battles. Sword Master or Swordfighter puts a maritimer in a position where he sacrifices Repair/Steering being favoured, which is quite vulnerable in various sea fight conditions. When we draw a comparison between these jobs and jobs that favour either Repair or Steering and Swordplay such as Filibuster, Senior Officer etc, The 15 attack bonus from Excalibur (down to around 4 attack in melee battle) will then not matter too much. Particularly Filibuster, where you also have First Aid favoured.

The bottom line is, unless you are not keen to Deck Battles and prefer to stick to land duels and dungeons, then maybe Excalibur is your weapon of choice. Otherwise, Kanemoto is actually a better one in terms of maritiming. This sword may not be the best, but neither is Excalibur.
